reasoning: The Swiss referendum 'No to a 10 Million Switzerland' aims to cap population at 10 million by limiting immigration. This is a right-wing populist initiative similar to past Swiss immigration referendums. Historically, Swiss voters have rejected most restrictive immigration initiatives (e.g., 2020 'Limitation Initiative' failed 61.7% to 38.3%). However, immigration concerns have grown across Europe. The initiative faces opposition from business groups and mainstream parties who value EU relations. Given historical patterns of similar initiatives failing and strong establishment opposition, passage seems unlikely but not impossible given shifting European sentiment on immigration.
